---
title: "Browse"
---

::: {.disclaimer}
Provisional model estimates, not IUCN assessments.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="filters">
  <input id="q" type="text" placeholder="Species name" style="min-width:260px">
  <select id="group"><option value="">All groups</option></select>
  <select id="status"><option value="">Any predicted status</option></select>
  <label style="align-self:center">
    Minimum probability
    <input id="minp" type="number" min="0" max="1" step="0.05" value="0" style="width:5rem">
  </label>
  <label style="align-self:center">
    <input id="lowonly" type="checkbox"> Only where models disagree
  </label>
</div>

<p id="count" style="color:#667"></p>
<div id="table"></div>

<script src="table.js"></script>
<script>
loadIndex(function (data) { renderControls(data); renderTable(data); });
</script>
```
